report_name: Play Ransomware Claims Attacks on Three US Companies

threat_actors.name: Play
threat_actors.description: A prolific ransomware group, also known as PlayCrypt, active since mid-2022. The group is a double-extortion operator that exfiltrates data before encrypting systems. On August 1, 2026, they claimed attacks on three U.S. companies: Cambridge Management, The Butcher Brothers, and Sigma Plastics Group.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Play ransomware group steals data before encrypting systems as part of their double-extortion model.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Play ransomware group deploys a payload to encrypt victim systems after data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The Play group uses exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities in public-facing infrastructure, such as Fortinet VPNs, as a typical initial access vector.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The Play group uses compromised Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) credentials as a typical initial access vector.

attack_patterns.name: Remote System Discovery
attack_patterns.description: The Play group uses legitimate system tools like AdFind for network reconnaissance to identify high-value targets.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: The Play group employs tools like Mimikatz to dump credentials and escalate privileges.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The Play group uses RDP and PsExec to move laterally across the network.

attack_patterns.name: Windows Management Instrumentation
attack_patterns.description: The Play group uses WMI for lateral movement across the network.

attack_patterns.name: Scheduled Task
attack_patterns.description: The Play group has been observed using scheduled tasks with commands like 'schtasks.exe /Create /SC ONLOGON' to establish persistence.

malware.name: Play Ransomware
malware.description: Ransomware payload used by the Play group. It encrypts files and appends the '.play' extension. It is used in double-extortion attacks where data is exfiltrated prior to encryption.

tools.name: AdFind
tools.description: A legitimate Active Directory query tool often dropped by Play affiliates for network reconnaissance.

tools.name: Mimikatz
tools.description: Used by the Play group to dump credentials and escalate privileges.

identities.name: Cambridge Management
identities.description: A U.S.-based property management firm listed on the Play ransomware group's data leak site on August 1, 2026.

identities.name: The Butcher Brothers
identities.description: A U.S.-based retail business listed on the Play ransomware group's data leak site on August 1, 2026.

identities.name: Sigma Plastics Group
identities.description: A U.S.-based manufacturing company listed on the Play ransomware group's data leak site on August 1, 2026.

infrastructure.name: Play Ransomware Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A public data leak site where the Play ransomware group lists its victims and threatens to publish exfiltrated data.

indicators.name: Play Ransomware Affiliate Tool - AdFind Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Play Ransomware Affiliate Tool - AdFind Execution
id: 2b9a7c3d-f1e0-4b8a-9c6d-3e5f7a1b4c9e
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of AdFind.exe, a legitimate Active Directory query tool often used by Play ransomware affiliates for reconnaissance.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-play-hits-cambridge-management/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1018
  - attack.discovery
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\AdFind.exe'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Play Ransomware Persistence via Scheduled Task
indicators.pattern:
title: Play Ransomware Persistence via Scheduled Task
id: 8d4c1b9a-7e3f-4a6d-9b8c-1e5f7a3b2c9d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a scheduled task set to run on logon, a technique observed being used by the Play ransomware group for persistence.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-play-hits-cambridge-management/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1053.005
  - attack.persistence
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '/Create'
      - '/SC'
      - 'ONLOGON'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Play Ransomware Encrypted File Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: Play Ransomware Encrypted File Detection
id: c1b9a7d4-e3f1-4b8a-9c6d-3e5f7a1b4c9e
status: experimental
description: Detects files being created or renamed with the '.play' extension, which is characteristic of the Play ransomware.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-play-hits-cambridge-management/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.play'
  condition: selection
